system.description:
Alistair stares down the man in Red. Drawing his Odachi to confront him. He moves in swinging it with ruthless tenacity. He stabs the blade into the ground after his first attack weaving handsigns and conjuring a massive wave of Water that turns into Sharks before they collide with their target. When the dust settles, Alistair looks for his enemy who seems to have been completely blow away by his assault. “Oh…Well…Looks like I went a tad bit overboard for training, hehe.”

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 13 excerpt.

The Tailless Beast

The Hoshigaki Clan is a clan that hails from the Land of Water and is famous for all the wrong reasons. Every prominent member of their clan has betrayed their home village in more than one way. But this does not brand them all as traitors, instead it has caused a vast majority of them to branch out and move to other villages to break the stigma of their history.

Hoshigaki Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Str

Speed: 30 feet

Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling, Nature

Weapon Proficiencies: Power Weapon Group & Weapons with the Heavy Property

Dark Vision: You have Darkvision up to 30 feet.

Passive Affinity: You have Water Release Affinity.

Amphibious: You can breathe air and Water.

Deep Speech: You can communicate with fish and other aquatic life.

Aquatic Adaptation: You have a Swimming and Water walking speed equal to your walking speed.

Hoshigaki Features

Deep Sea Predator

1st Level Clan Feature

As a Hoshigaki, your physical features are unique and different from everyone around you. Your clan is known for aqua blue skin, recessed eyes, gill like features on your face or neck, and the unique ability to breath in water as easily as breathing air. But this is surface level. When peering deeper, you will find that all Hoshigaki carry features of these deep-sea predators of different degrees. Select two Predator Traits. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels.

Apex Gaze

When an enemy look into your eyes, they see an Apex predator. A beast of a person who doesn’t see them as an equal, but as prey. You can take the Demoralize skill action as a Bonus action, and you can attempt it on creatures any number of times instead of once per hour.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the ranks of Demoralized you inflict by +1. Beginning at 15th level, when you take the Demoralize skill action, you can instead target all creatures you can see within 20 feet of you.

Beast of the Sea

Your stamina is unmatched. Increase your Hit points and Chakra points by an amount equal to your level.

Commander of the Deep

You learn a modified version of the Summoning Technique Ninjutsu, with a contract with the Shark tribe. The Shark tribe you are contracted with are a bit more versatile than other shark tribes. When you summon these sharks, they are summoned in a large bubble of Water that they use for land travel, using half their swimming speed to traverse the land.

Shark Skinned

Your skin is rough, slightly scaled, tougher and more resilient to damage. While you are not wearing Heavy Armor, you have Bonus DR equal to your constitution modifier. Beginning at 11th level, when a creature would deal damage to you with a melee attack, they take slashing damage, equal to your Constitution modifier.

Tide Locked

Your close affinity with water release chakra, makes your innate control over it uniquely suited to deal with extremely aggressive foes. Once per turn, when you deal cold damage to a creature as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword, you can select one of the affected creatures to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you can choose to have either their speed reduced by 10 until the end of their next turn (This reduction becomes 20 at 7th and 30 at 15th level), or increase chakra damage they take by +2 until the beginning of your next turn. (This damage bonus increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.)

Tiger Sharks Maw

Your teeth are sharp, serrated and can tear through flesh with ease. Losing teeth for you is a minor inconvenience since you regrow teeth like people regrow nails. You gain a special Bite Attack, which you can use in place of an attack made with your attack action.

Bite. Make a melee jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see or sense. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu ability modifier in piercing damage. This attack has a +1 bonus to its critical threat range. Beginning at 7th level, creatures who take damage from your bite must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Grappled by you. Beginning at 15th level, creatures that fail their saving throw also gain 1 rank of Bleed.

Prey Sense

Your senses are tuned to grant you awareness to those close enough to be considered a victim to your assault. You gain 10 feet of blindsight.

Beginning at 7th level, increase your blindsight to 20 feet, and it doubles while submerged in water.

Beginning at 15th level, increase your blindsight to 30 feet.

Ravenous Chakra

| #### Apex Predator / Battle Amp / You embody the power of the Apex of the sea. / Ocean Bond. When Water Walking or swimming, double your movement speed. / Cold Blooded. Creatures with the following conditions, increase the damage they take from you by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th levels (Bleed, Concussed, Dazed, Demoralized, Grappled, Restrained or Shaken) / Ravenous Aura. [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] you deal can trigger your Ravenous Chakra clan feature, as if it were a C-Rank Jutsu. You cannot gain temporary chakra using Ravenous Chakra this way. / Limitless Blue. Jutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword gain their additional effects as if near a sufficient source of Water. / Efficient Recovery. Once per turn, increase Temporary Hit points gained from allied or self-sourced effects by +4. This increases to +6 at 7th level and +8 at 15th level. |

1st Level Clan Feature

As a Hoshigaki, your body yearns to consume the Chakra of others. The stronger your enemies, the stronger you can become, using their energy to fuel you. Beginning at 1st level, once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu with a nature release keyword, you deal additional chakra damage to the affected creatures equal to the rank of the jutsu cast; D-Rank: 2d6, C-Rank: 3d6, B-Rank: 4d6, A-Rank: 5d6, S-Rank: 6d6.

When you reach 7th level, when you deal chakra damage as a result of this feature, you gain temporary chakra equal to the number of dice rolled.

Beginning at 15th level, if your jutsu would clash with an opposing creatures jutsu, you treat the opposing jutsu as if it’s one rank lower for the purposes of the clash check. If you win this clash, you double the chakra damage dice rolled as part of this feature.

Apex Berserker

3rd Level Clan Feature

You’ve learned to tap into your bestial heritage, becoming more shark like in your physical features, turning you into more of a monster than a man.

As a bonus action, you transform, enter your Apex Predator state. This form has you take on a shark like form, growing large gills, large wing link fins from your shoulders, and web between your fingers. You can remain in this state for 1 minute. Once you enter this state, if you enter it again before completing a long rest, you gain 1 rank of exhaustion.

Beginning at 11th level, you can enter this state once per rest before gaining ranks of exhaustion.

Predatory Surges

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your bloodline can only take you so far in this world. You begin to learn how to utilize your brutish physicality in ways unique to your clan known as Predator Surges. Predator Surges are special techniques that you can utilize as part of combat to infuse your onslaught with Hoshigaki power. Unlike other clans that learn and can never adapt, your clan utilizes an instinctual form of combat similar to a Shark, allowing you to learn the useful techniques and forget the ones that aren’t useful. When you complete a long rest, select two Predator Surges from the following list. You can use one surge as part of any trigger. If a Surge requires a saving throw, use your highest jutsu saving throw to determine the surges DC.

Predators Terrain

Trigger: As part of casting a Jutsu

When you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword that affects an area, you can use this surge to cause the affected area to become difficult terrain for the next minute for all creatures, excluding yourself and up to 3 creatures of your choice.

Creatures that attempt to move through this area can spend 10 chakra to ignore this difficult terrain effect until the end of their turn.

Predators Drag

Trigger: As part of making a melee attack

When you score a hit with a melee attack, you can use this surge to suddenly bite down, or grab an enemy in such a way that you have them held down. The affected creature becomes Grappled and you immediately can move up to twice your full speed pulling them along with you. While grappled in this way the affected creature cannot take reactions. Once you’ve finished this movement, you end the grapple on the affected creature.

Predators Clarity

Trigger: As part of taking damage

When you take damage from a creature, you can use this surge to mark the triggering creature until the end of your next turn. When you do, you become aware of them if they are invisible or are hidden from you.

Predators Rend

Trigger: As part of making a melee attack

When you deal damage as a result of a melee attack, you deliver it via your sharpened teeth, which allows you to rend your opponent’s defenses, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you reduce their DR by 2 for the next minute. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

Predators Crash

Trigger: As part of casting a Jutsu

When you cast a jutsu with the Water release keyword that affects a creature protected by a Barrier, you can use this Surge to destabilize the barrier, causing half of the damage you deal to also affect creatures protected by the barrier.

Predators Feeding

Trigger: As part of taking damage

When you take damage from a creature as a result of a melee attack you can use this Surge to spend your reaction, to take the Attack action, targeting the triggering creature with attacks made as a result.

Abyssal Wayfinder

7th Level Clan Feature

Your close affinity with the seas, oceans and lakes grant you and instinctual knowledge about the seas that others would spend lifetimes trying to match. While observing a body of water you can predict the weather, tides and visibility while traversing this water by making a Nature check vs a DC 5.

Additionally, while you are swimming, allies within 20 feet of you that attempt to follow you, can spend their Actions on their turns to swim behind you, following your swim trail, always ending keeping up with you and never being lost no matter how murky or dark the water is.

Finally, by spending 10 minutes submerged in a body of water, you can remove 1 rank of exhaustion as the waves gentle wash away your fatigue. You can do this once per rest.

Ichthyic Armorer

7th Level Clan Feature

The Weapons you wield while well-crafted have always been missing something. Something that makes it feel yours. By spending 1 Downtime, you are able to perform a Hoshigaki ritual, hunting down different aquatic life and using their remains to enhance the weapons you utilize in combat. Select two of the following weapon grafts, which you use to enhance your weapon with, granting it their listed effects. A weapon can never have more than 2 grafts at a time, and you can only have a single weapon grafted at once. Any new grafts you place on a weapon with them, causes the previous ones to be dispelled.

Raking Dermis (Shark Skin). This weapon gains Pierce 2, and it can deal either slashing or piercing damage.

Wing Guard (Manta). This weapon gains Blocking 1, if it didn’t already. You can now, as a reaction to taking damage, use this weapon to parry some incoming damage, reducing the damage you take by an amount equal to its [Weapon Damage].

Sawtooth (Sawfish). Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon damage] to a creature with temporary hit or chakra points, you reduce them to 0, before applying damage.

Scale Plate (Coelacanth). This weapon gains the Fortified armor property.

Tiger Pattern (Tiger Shark). On your turn, if you hit two or more creatures, you gain +2 DR for each creature hit, until the beginning of your next turn.

Marlin Imprint (Marlin). Attacks with this weapon while underwater gain 2 ranks of Mastery.

Angler Lure (Anglerfish). As a Bonus action, you can force a creature in range to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they gain 1 rank of Shaken and they have disadvantage on attacks targeting creatures other than you until the end of their next turn.

Abyssal Bulwark

11th Level Clan Feature

You are clad in flesh hardened by the pressures of the deep and perseverance. You gain resistance to Chakra and Cold Damage. Also, when you are hit with a Critical Hit, you gain a Will of Fire.

Additionally, while in your Apex Predator state, you gain immunity to Cold Damage, and you have advantage on saving throws made to resist the Bleed, Dazed and Stunned conditions.

King of the Deep

15th Level Clan Feature

In battle you are the king of the oceanic waves and your inherent ability to control water shines through with this pinnacle of your Hoshigaki bloodline. As an Action, all sources of water within 120 feet of you collects around you and creates a massive maelstrom with you in the center. All sources of water within range, that occupy no more than 8 spaces are dispelled. If a source of water occupies more than 8 spaces, you only draw water from it as the body of water is too large to drain entirely.

For the next minute, you conjure a 30-foot radius spinning column of darkened water, centered on you, that moves with you with the following properties. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest;

Creatures in this waters area are submerged.

The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures.

Allies creatures can swim with no obstruction.

Ranged attacks made by hostile creatures into or through the maelstrom have disadvantage.

Hostile creatures that end their turn inside take 4d6 cold damage as if from a Ninjutsu you cast with the water release keyword.

While inside your maelstrom, your melee attacks gain the Reach 2 property if they didn’t already, and on a hit, affected creatures are pulled 5 feet closer to you.

Jutsu with the fire release keyword that would be cast while inside the maelstrom has its fire damage reduced by 4 damage die.

When a hostile creature inside the maelstrom cast a jutsu, its cost is increased by +8, and its damage is reduced by 2 damage die. You gain temporary chakra equal to the rank of the jutsu cast (D-Rank: 2, C-Rank: 3, B-Rank: 4, A-Rank: 5, S-Rank: 6.)
